title: tenant id "default" is a reserved sentinel that silently 403s all flow auth
body: Never register or use the literal tenant id `default`. `DefaultExecutionAuthorizationPolicy` treats `default` as a reserved sentinel and denies every flow authorization for it, regardless of the requester's roles/permissions -- a fully-ADMIN-roled requester under tenant `default` is still denied with HTTP 403. As of the ARCH-15 fix (2026-07-12) `TenantRegistryService.create()` fails fast (HTTP 400) if a tenant id normalizes to `default`, and the policy logs a WARNING pointing at tenant registration. Use any other tenant id (e.g. `tenant-a`, `acme`); pick a real tenant id when seeding test users.
